rows.role_title: President of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: In his address datelined "Ulundi: 24 August 2019" and headed as by "THE HONOURABLE VELENKOSINI HLABISA MPL PRESIDENT OF THE INKATHA FREEDOM PARTY", he says "I stand here, elected by you to lead, and I accept".

locator.section: Heading block, date line and the paragraph beginning "I am also fully conscious"

rows.role_title: President Emeritus of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: The same address says that "as the newly elected President of the IFP" he asked "that conference pass a resolution today declaring Prince Buthelezi “President Emeritus of the IFP”", and that this was done.

locator.section: Paragraph beginning "Therefore, as the newly elected President of the IFP"
